messages.content: You are a terse capability-probe target. Answer exactly what is asked, with no preamble and no closing remarks.

Define a(1)=7 and a(n)=a(n-1)+gcd(n,a(n-1)) for n>1. Work out every term from a(2) to a(60) one step at a time, showing each gcd you use, then list every n in that range where a(n)-a(n-1) is greater than 1, and finally state a(60). Be exhaustive and check your arithmetic as you go.
